description.en: The custom name of the listener.
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

description.zh:
传统型负载均衡监听协议。取值：
- **tcp**
- **udp**
- **http**
- **https**
description.en:
The protocol used by the listener. Valid values:

- **tcp**

- **udp**

- **http**

- **https**

description.zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的ID列表，最多支持10个实例ID。


> 非SDK调用，请使用LoadBalancerId.N形式添加参数。
description.en:
The IDs of the CLB instances. You can specify up to 10 instance IDs.

> If you do not use the SDK to call this operation, use the LoadBalancerId.N parameter.

description.zh:
分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。

取值范围：**1**~**100**，入参为空时，默认值：**20**。
description.en:
The number of entries to return in each call.

Valid values: **1** to **100**. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value **20** is used.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值。
description.en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- If this is your first query and no subsequent queries are to be sent, ignore this parameter.

- If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call.

description.zh:
传统型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。

> 当您所选地域的Endpoint（服务地址）为slb.aliyuncs.com时，`RegionId`必填。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the CLB instance is deployed.

You can call the [](t2293290.xdita#)operation to query the most recent region list.

> If the endpoint of the selected region is slb.aliyuncs.com, the `RegionId` parameter is required.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The key of the tag. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key must be 1 to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 查询负载均衡监听列表

descriptions.zh:
- 您已经创建了传统型负载均衡实例。具体操作，请参见[CreateLoadBalancer](~~27577~~)。
- 您已经为创建的传统型负载均衡实例配置了监听。具体操作，请参见：

    - [CreateLoadBalancerUDPListener](~~27595~~)
    - [CreateLoadBalancerTCPListener](~~27594~~)
    - [CreateLoadBalancerHTTPListener](~~27592~~)  
    - [CreateLoadBalancerHTTPSListener](~~27593~~)
descriptions.en:
- A CLB instance is created. For more information, see [](t2280360.xdita#).

- One or more listeners are added to the CLB instance. For more information, see the following topics:

  - [](t2280398.xdita#)

  - [](t2280397.xdita#)

  - [](t2280395.xdita#)

  - [](t2280396.xdita#)

example.legacyCli: aliyun slb DescribeLoadBalancerListeners --region cn-hangzhou --ListenerPort 443 --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description HTTPS_443 --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --LoadBalancerId.1 'lb-uf6so8u4g35prnvsw0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ListenerProtocol http
